sections.heading: Glossary term: Global Warming
sections.body: Global warming is a warming of a planet's atmosphere by greenhouse gases, such as water molecules, carbon dioxide, methane, etc. This is caused by an increase in the greenhouse effect where more infrared radiation is trapped by the atmosphere, thus increasing the global mean temperature of a planet. The sources of greenhouse gases can be natural or (on Earth) additionally caused by human industrial activity. Global warming on Earth will have significant very long-term effects on the planet, including short- and medium-term changes in local weather patterns, habitat destruction, and sea level rise.

sections.source_html:
Glossary term: Global Warming

Also known as climate change

Description: Global warming is a warming of a planet's atmosphere by greenhouse gases, such as water molecules, carbon dioxide, methane, etc. This is caused by an increase in the greenhouse effect where more infrared radiation is trapped by the atmosphere, thus increasing the global mean temperature of a planet. The sources of greenhouse gases can be natural or (on Earth) additionally caused by human industrial activity. Global warming on Earth will have significant very long-term effects on the planet, including short- and medium-term changes in local weather patterns, habitat destruction, and sea level rise.

Related Terms:

  • Greenhouse Effect


See this term in other languages

Term and definition status: This term and its definition have been approved by a research astronomer and a teacher

The OAE Multilingual Glossary is a project of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Education (OAE) in collaboration with the IAU Office of Astronomy Outreach (OAO). The terms and definitions were chosen, written and reviewed by a collective effort from the OAE, the OAE Centers and Nodes, the OAE National Astronomy Education Coordinators (NAECs) and other volunteers. You can find a full list of credits here. All glossary terms and their definitions are released under a Creative Commons CC BY-4.0 license and should be credited to "IAU OAE".

If you notice a factual error in this glossary definition then please get in touch.
sections.body_ru: Глобальное потепление — это потепление атмосферы планеты парниковыми газами, такими как молекулы воды, углекислый газ, метан и т. д. Это вызвано усилением парникового эффекта, при котором атмосфера удерживает больше инфракрасного излучения, что повышает среднюю глобальную температуру планеты. Источники парниковых газов могут быть естественными или (на Земле) дополнительно вызванными промышленной деятельностью человека. Глобальное потепление на Земле будет иметь значительные очень долгосрочные последствия для планеты, включая краткосрочные и среднесрочные изменения местных погодных условий, разрушение местообитаний и повышение уровня моря.

media.caption_en: This map visualizes the changes in surface air temperature across the globe over the past half-century. Through meticulous analysis of annual averages, the map highlights the most significant trends in temperature change, particularly emphasizing shifts in northern latitudes and over land masses.
media.caption_ru: Эта карта визуализирует изменения приземной температуры воздуха по всему земному шару за последние полвека. Благодаря тщательному анализу среднегодовых значений карта выделяет наиболее значимые тенденции изменения температуры, особенно подчёркивая сдвиги в северных широтах и над массивами суши.
media.alt_en: A map showing increasing temperatures across almost the whole world with the most warming in the Arctic
